_README: Contact details and switches. Change them here and they change everywhere on both language versions.

contact._email: Live on Google Workspace since 24 November 2026 (alias on luca@bookednow.co.za, DKIM on). Change the address here only — every page reads it from this file.
contact._whatsappNumber: CONFIRM this is the right number for LUTU. Digits only, international format, no + or spaces.
contact.whatsappPrefill: Hi LUTU, I'd like a quote for a shoot
contact.whatsappPrefillAr: مرحباً لوتو، أود الحصول على عرض سعر لجلسة تصوير

social._note: CONFIRM @lutucreative is claimed on each platform before launch. Leave a handle empty to hide it.

domain._canonical: CONFIRM lutu.co.za is registered. Used for canonical URLs, hreflang, sitemap and Open Graph.

analytics._enabled: Set true once the domain is live and the Plausible site is created. No cookie banner needed either way.

seasonBanner._bookByDate: Shown as 'Book by <date> for Ramadan content.' Set to a real date, e.g. '15 January 2027'. Set enabled:false to hide the banner entirely.

caseStudies._enabled: Stays false until real client work exists. When true, the 'Our work' section appears.
